turns.doctor_question: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
turns.patient_response: Hi. Well, I'm here because... things have just gotten out of hand. After I eat too much, I keep going into the bathroom and making myself throw up. I do it so I won't gain weight, but it's gotten to the point where I'm genuinely scared I can't stop doing it.

symptom_reasoning.S048: The patient explicitly reports repeatedly making themselves throw up after eating in order to prevent weight gain.

turns.doctor_question: In addition to making yourself vomit, have you done anything else like severely restricting your food, using laxatives, or exercising a lot to try to control your weight?
turns.patient_response: No, I haven't really done any of that. I don't use laxatives or anything, and I definitely don't exercise a lot. I work as a mechanic, so I'm on my feet and moving around all day at the shop, but I don't go to the gym or run or anything to try to burn off what I eat. And I don't really starve myself either. It's just the throwing up.

symptom_reasoning.S047: The patient explicitly denies engaging in non-purging compensatory behaviors, stating they do not starve themselves or exercise to burn off what they eat.
symptom_reasoning.S048: The patient affirms using self-induced vomiting to control weight by stating 'It's just the throwing up'.
